description: tonyd2wild's DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (native image input, bundled DSpark draft head) on two Sparks with SGLang tensor parallel 2 over RoCE, from the SGLang DeepSeek-V4 cookbook's verified dgx-spark flash-vision fp4 balanced cell: b12x MoE runner, DSpark speculative decoding, 327,680-token context, about a 507K-token KV pool, thinking off by default. Image: the SGLang DGX Spark preview build lmsysorg/sglang:dev-v4f-2dgx-v2 (branch b12x-vision @ 452239a74f), pinned by digest and used unmodified. Upstream calls this a staging checkpoint: untuned, the DSpark accept length observed was 1.7 to 2.6 tokens per step, and the TP4 lane is only planned (not packaged). Same-creator alternative for this model and Spark count: the vLLM DSpark recipe. Host prerequisite from upstream: the FP8-to-FP4 weight conversion needs tens of GB of host memory on GB10, so upstream adds a 48 GB swapfile per node as a safety net (peak swap use about 36 GB). Licences (information only): recipe MIT, model MIT, SGLang Apache-2.0. Upstream figures (about 45 tok/s median real-prompt single stream, 75 tok/s aggregate at 16 streams) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. Thinking default is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Thinking off unless a request enables it (upstream default). Memory: mem-fraction-static 0.80 is the creator's cookbook value and floor (minimum viable 0.731), with the creator's 507,904-token pool pinned by max-total-tokens. The load-time FP8-to-FP4 conversion needs host memory beyond the weights: the creator adds a 48 GB swapfile as a safety net (with the three loader flags set here, model-loader-extra-config, weight-loader-drop-cache-after-load and startup-weight-load-mode serial; about 36 GB of swap was used during load before those flags). The 2026-10-27 run on our Sparks observed 127.28e9 during that conversion (with 16 GB swap; the old guard killed it). The declared peak (112,530,585,191, static allocation plus overhead) does not include swap-absorbed load bytes; whether they count in peak_bytes is a pending owner decision. The swap profile setting (64 GiB default) provides the swap.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision-Exp SGLang two Sparks (tonyd2wild)
